source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Some rules let a player secure an **objective**. The securing player keeps control even without any units in range. That protection ends if the opponent has a higher **[Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control)** there when a phase ends. A tie leaves the securing player in control.

release.condition: opponent's level of control over the objective is greater than the securing player's

basis: 14.03 release needs a greater level, not an equal one

example.trigger: end of its owner's Command phase

sidePanel.topic: abilities triggered on controlling versus securing an objective

tiesOnSecuredObjectives.how: explicit, by the 14.02 tie exception read with the 14.03 strictly-greater release

explicit.terrainObjectiveRange: a model is in range while within the terrain area (14.02)
explicit.frameMeasuring: closest point on the model whenever a rule refers to its position relative to anything else (17.02)
explicit.defaultMeasuring: closest part of the model's base (01.04)

diagramInference.partlyWithinCounts: inferred from 'within' (OC 3 vehicle) beside 'wholly within' (OC 2 vehicle), both summed into blue's 5

modelPartlyInTerrainArea.readingNotPrinted: a FRAME model's closest point inside the area would make it within; applying 17.02 to an area is a reading

gdcOnly.within: any part of the base within the distance
gdcOnly.whollyWithinTerrainArea: no part of the base outside the area's footprint

gdcOnly.effect: control is determined first, before other end-of-phase or end-of-turn rules
general sequencing of simultaneous rules (from the earlier visibility batch)

levelOfControlTiming.openCase: the page 11 example secures at the end of the Command phase on a control test; whether that test sees control determined in the same end step is not printed
